strategy.mission: Build Jarvis into a reliable autonomous supervisor that can plan, execute, verify, learn, and safely improve itself.
principles: Never treat a task as completed without evidence.
Create operator review tasks for risky or unclear changes.
Keep backend healthy before expanding features.
Use evidence reports, smoke tests, and artifacts as source of truth.
Improve tool execution before improving abstract planning.
Preserve secrets and avoid exposing credentials.

strategic_blocks.goal: Reliable mission continuity, queues, priorities, safe recovery, and evidence-based completion.
Real tools, file actions, API actions, n8n actions, Google Workspace actions, and structured tool chains.
Long-running autonomous loops with memory, scheduling, retries, and operator-safe escalation.
Self-improvement only through evidence gates, code gates, rollback plans, and smoke tests.
